english.title: Fail to notify staff of property found within Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having found property, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PROPERTY..), to which byelaw 11.1 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 applied and which you believed to be lost or abandoned, failed to notify a member of airport staff, and airport official or a constable as soon as reasonably practicable and inform that person of the place and circumstances in which it was found
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 11.2 and 2.3 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: This offence is subject to the provisions of the Custom and Excise Acts and is does not apply to members of staff of the Airport, Airport Officials or Constables.
